				local move, stop
				move = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
					if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then wearAt(i.Position.X) end
				end)
				stop = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
					if IsPrimaryInput(i) then move:Disconnect(); stop:Disconnect() end
				end)
			end)
			optCard(3)
			optionRow(1, "StatTrak™", statBtn)
			local valueBox = box("0")
			local valueRow = optionRow(2, "Value", valueBox)
			valueRow:FindFirstChild("OptLabel").TextColor3 = MUTED
			local function refreshPreview()
				if type(options.preview) ~= "function" or not current then return end
				previewWorld:ClearAllChildren()
				local p = picks[team][current.key] or {}
				pcall(options.preview, previewWorld, previewCamera, {
					team = team, category = current.category, index = current.index, item = current.item, skin = p.skin, pick = p,
				})
			end
			-- Full screen: the model area takes the page; toolbar and skins hide.
			local previewFull = false
			-- Full screen (Neverlose): the model area grows over the whole window
			-- with the item's name on top and a close cross; closing shrinks it
			-- back into the page.
			local fullTitle = New("TextLabel", {
				Name = "FullTitle", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16), Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 26),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextColor3 = TEXT, TextSize = 20, Font = FONT, Visible = false,
			}, preview)
			local fullClose = New("TextButton", {
				Name = "FullClose", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "×", TextColor3 = MUTED, TextSize = 22, Font = FONT, Visible = false,
			}, preview)
			local homeParent, homePos, homeSize
			local function setFull(on)
				if on == previewFull then return end
				previewFull = on
				local scale = GetMainFrameScale()
				local from = preview.AbsolutePosition
				if on then
					if optionsPlate.Visible then optionsPlate.Visible = false; optionsPlate:SetAttribute("Open", false) end
					homeParent, homePos, homeSize = preview.Parent, preview.Position, preview.Size
					local fromSize = preview.AbsoluteSize
					preview.Parent = MainFrame
					local host = MainFrame.AbsolutePosition
					preview.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((from.X - host.X) / scale, (from.Y - host.Y) / scale)
					preview.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fromSize.X / scale, fromSize.Y / scale)
					ApplyZIndexLadder(preview, NextPopupZ())
					fullTitle.Text = title.Text
					fullTitle.Visible, fullClose.Visible = true, true
					Tween(preview, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.04 }, 0.38,
						Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
				else
					fullTitle.Visible, fullClose.Visible = false, false
					local target = homeParent.AbsolutePosition
					local host = MainFrame.AbsolutePosition
					local back = UDim2.fromOffset((target.X - host.X) / scale + homePos.X.Offset, (target.Y - host.Y) / scale + homePos.Y.Offset)
					local w = homeParent.AbsoluteSize.X / scale * homeSize.X.Scale + homeSize.X.Offset
					local h = homeParent.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale * homeSize.Y.Scale + homeSize.Y.Offset
					Tween(preview, { Position = back, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 }, 0.32,
						Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					task.delay(0.33, function()
						if previewFull then return end
						preview.Parent = homeParent
						preview.Position, preview.Size = homePos, homeSize
					end)
				end
			end
			fullBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setFull(not previewFull) end)
			fullClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setFull(false) end)
			local function saveOption(field, value)
				if not current then return end
				local p = picks[team][current.key] or {}
				p[field] = value
				picks[team][current.key] = p
				if field == "skin" or field == "type" or field == "wear" then task.defer(refreshPreview) end
				if type(options.onOption) == "function" then pcall(options.onOption, team, current.category, current.index, current.item, field, value) end
			end
			inv.saveOption = saveOption -- (the wear bar above uses it)
			nameBox.FocusLost:Connect(function() saveOption("name", nameBox.Text) end)
			seedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function() saveOption("seed", tonumber(seedBox.Text) or 0) end)
			-- Neverlose list: a small plate under the button with every value, the
			-- current one ticked; picking closes it. One open at a time, clicking
			-- outside (or the same button) closes it.
			local listFrame, listAnchor
			local function closeList()
				local f = listFrame
				if not f then return end
				listFrame, listAnchor = nil, nil
				UnregisterPopup(f)
				SmoothClose(f, 0.12, function() if f.Parent then f:Destroy() end end)
			end
			local function listMenu(anchor, values, currentValue, onPick)
				if listFrame and listAnchor == anchor then closeList() return end
				closeList()
				local width = 120
				for _, v in ipairs(values) do width = math.max(width, math.ceil(MeasureText(tostring(v), 13, FONT)) + 46) end
				local f = New("Frame", {
					Name = "ItemListMenu", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, #values * 24 + (#values - 1) * 2 + 8),
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 24), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 60,
				}, MainFrame)
				New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, f)
				New("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Transparency = 0.92, Thickness = 1 }, f)
				-- Rows live in an inner frame: a frame with a list layout gets no
				-- drop shadow (AttachShadow skips it).
				local body = New("Frame", { Name = "ListBody", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 60 }, f)
				New("UIPadding", {
					PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4),
				}, body)
				New("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, body)
				for i, v in ipairs(values) do
					local isCurrent = v == currentValue
					local row = New("TextButton", {
						Name = "ListOption", LayoutOrder = i, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
						BackgroundTransparency = isCurrent and 0.95 or 1, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", ZIndex = 61,
					}, body)
					New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }, row)
					New("TextLabel", {
						Name = "ListOptionText", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Text = tostring(v), TextColor3 = isCurrent and TEXT or MUTED, TextSize = 13, Font = FONT,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 62,
					}, row)
					New("ImageLabel", {
						Name = "ListTick", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = "rbxassetid://10709790644", ImageColor3 = TEXT, Visible = isCurrent, ZIndex = 62,
					}, row)
					local lift = New("UIPadding", { Name = "Lift", PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8) }, row)
					task.delay(i * 0.02, function()
						if row.Parent then Tween(lift, { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 0) }, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out) end
					end)
					row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if Library._hoverBlocked(row) then return end if not isCurrent then Tween(row, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.96 }, 0.1) end end)
					row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if not isCurrent then Tween(row, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.1) end end)
					row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
						closeList()
						onPick(v)
					end)
				end
				listFrame, listAnchor = f, anchor
				ApplyZIndexLadder(f, NextPopupZ())
				-- Under the button, right edges lined up (above it near the screen bottom).
				local function place()
					if not f.Parent or not anchor.Parent then return end
					local safePos, safeSize = PopupSafeArea()
					local h = f.AbsoluteSize.Y
					local x = anchor.AbsolutePosition.X + anchor.AbsoluteSize.X - f.AbsoluteSize.X
					local y = anchor.AbsolutePosition.Y + anchor.AbsoluteSize.Y + 4
					if y + h > safePos.Y + safeSize.Y - 6 then y = anchor.AbsolutePosition.Y - h - 4 end
					MovePopupToAbsolute(f, math.max(x, safePos.X + 6), y)
				end
				place()
				task.defer(place)
				WindowObj._glassPlate(f)
				SmoothOpen(f, WindowObj._plateAlpha, 0.16)
				RegisterPopup(f, closeList, anchor)
			end
			-- Stickers: each slot opens the sticker list (options.stickers, or a
			-- default set); the pick is saved per item and sent to onSticker.
			local STICKERS = type(options.stickers) == "table" and options.stickers
				or { "None", "Crown (Foil)", "Howl", "iBUYPOWER", "Titan", "Natus Vincere", "Team Liquid", "Vitality", "FaZe Clan" }
			local function paintStickers()
				local p = pickOf()
				for i = 1, 5 do
					local slot = stickers:FindFirstChild("StickerSlot" .. i)
					local name = type(p.stickers) == "table" and p.stickers[i] or nil
					if slot then
						local on = name ~= nil and name ~= "None"
						Tween(slot, { BackgroundColor3 = on and mainColor or Color3.fromRGB(40, 42, 54), BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.15 or 0.3 }, 0.18)
						slot.StickerMark.Text = on and string.sub(name, 1, 1) or ""
					end
				end
			end
			inv.paintStickers = paintStickers
			inv.pickSticker = function(i, slot)
				local p = pickOf()
				local cur = type(p.stickers) == "table" and p.stickers[i] or "None"
				listMenu(slot, STICKERS, cur, function(name)
					local list = type(p.stickers) == "table" and p.stickers or {}
					list[i] = name ~= "None" and name or nil
					saveOption("stickers", list)
					paintStickers()
					if type(options.onSticker) == "function" and current then
						pcall(options.onSticker, team, current.category, current.index, current.item, i, name)
					end
				end)
			end
			local function cycleClick(btn, values, field)
				btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					listMenu(btn, values, pickOf()[field] or values[1], function(v)
						btn.Text = v .. " ›"
						saveOption(field, v)
					end)
				end)
			end

			-- Second card (Neverlose): Model / Overlay / Arms / Overlay, each a
			-- colour square + material; then Colorize StatTrak and Glow (colour +
			-- switch), Cloth Physics and Remove Sleeves (switch).
			optCard(4)
			local MATERIALS = { "Disabled", "Shaded", "Solid", "Glow", "Glow Outline", "Iridescent", "Water Flow", "Glossy" }
			local refreshers = {}
			local function colorOf(field)
				local c = pickOf()[field]
				if type(c) == "table" and #c == 3 then return Color3.new(c[1], c[2], c[3]) end
				return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			end
			local function swatch(parent, field)
				local sw = New("ImageButton", {
					Name = "OptSwatch", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
					Image = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 23,
				}, parent)
				New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }, sw)
				local syncing = false
				local picker = AcrylicBlur.CreateColorPicker(sw, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), function(c)
					if not syncing then saveOption(field, { c.R, c.G, c.B }) end
				end)
				-- Another item opened: show its colour without saving it again.
				table.insert(refreshers, function()
					syncing = true
					picker.Set(colorOf(field))
					Tween(sw, { BackgroundColor3 = colorOf(field) }, 0.2)
					syncing = false
				end)
				return sw
			end
			local function holder(width)
				local h = New("Frame", { Name = "OptControls", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, nil)
				New("UIListLayout", {
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				}, h)
				return h
			end
			local function materialRow(order, label, field)
				local h = holder(130)
				local sw = swatch(h, field .. "Color")
				sw.LayoutOrder = 1
				local btn = cycle(MATERIALS)
				-- As wide as its text: the colour square sits right beside "Disabled ›".
				btn.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
				btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22)
				btn.LayoutOrder = 2
				btn.Parent = h
				cycleClick(btn, MATERIALS, field)
				table.insert(refreshers, function() btn.Text = (pickOf()[field] or MATERIALS[1]) .. " ›" end)
				optionRow(order, label, h)
			end
			local function switchControl(parent, field)
				-- Same switch as in the plates: 33x20 track (visible when off), 16px knob.
				local OFF = Color3.fromRGB(36, 38, 50)
				local track = New("TextButton", {
					Name = "OptSwitch", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(33, 20), BackgroundColor3 = OFF,
					AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", ZIndex = 23,
				}, parent)
				New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, track)
				local knob = New("Frame", {
					Name = "Knob", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(139, 145, 157), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 24,
				}, track)
				New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, knob)
				local function paint(on, instant)
					local goalTrack = { BackgroundColor3 = on and mainColor or OFF }
					local goalKnob = { Position = on and UDim2.fromOffset(15, 2) or UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
						BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(139, 145, 157) }
					if instant then
						track.BackgroundColor3, knob.Position, knob.BackgroundColor3 = goalTrack.BackgroundColor3, goalKnob.Position, goalKnob.BackgroundColor3
					else
						Tween(track, goalTrack, 0.15)
						Tween(knob, goalKnob, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					end
				end
				track.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					local on = not pickOf()[field]
					saveOption(field, on)
					paint(on)
				end)
				table.insert(refreshers, function() paint(pickOf()[field] == true, true) end)
				return track
			end
			local function switchRow(order, label, field, withColor)
				local h = holder(76)
				if withColor then swatch(h, field .. "Color").LayoutOrder = 1 end
				switchControl(h, field).LayoutOrder = 2
				optionRow(order, label, h)
			end

			switchRow(13, "Remove Sleeves", "removeSleeves", false)
			-- Closes like other popups: clicking outside it (or Options again).
			local function closeOptions()
				if not optionsPlate:GetAttribute("Open") then return end
				optionsPlate:SetAttribute("Open", false)
				UnregisterPopup(optionsPlate)
				SmoothClose(optionsPlate, 0.14)
			end
			optionsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if optionsPlate.Visible and optionsPlate:GetAttribute("Open") then
					closeOptions()
					return
				end
				optionsPlate:SetAttribute("Open", true)
				ApplyZIndexLadder(optionsPlate, NextPopupZ())
				-- As tall as its rows, at most down to the page bottom (then it scrolls).
				local function fitOptions()
					-- Rows' own heights (+6 gaps, +20 padding): known before the
					-- layout has run, so the plate opens at its full size at once.
					local scale = GetMainFrameScale()
					local function height(o)
						if o.AutomaticSize ~= Enum.AutomaticSize.Y then return o.Size.Y.Offset end
						local h, k = 8, 0 -- card padding 4 + 4
						for _, c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
							if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.Visible then h = h + height(c); k = k + 1 end
						end
						return h
					end
					local content, n = 20, 0
					for _, c in ipairs(optionsPlate:GetChildren()) do
						if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.Visible then content = content + height(c); n = n + 1 end
					end
					content = content + math.max(0, n - 1) * 6
					local room = itemPage.AbsoluteSize.Y / scale - 48
					optionsPlate.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, math.max(60, math.min(content, room)))
				end
				fitOptions()
				task.defer(fitOptions)
				SmoothOpen(optionsPlate, 0, 0.18)
				RegisterPopup(optionsPlate, closeOptions, optionsBtn)
				do
					local p = pickOf()
					nameBox.Text = p.name or ""
					seedBox.Text = p.seed and tostring(p.seed) or ""
					wearBtn.Text = (p.wear or WEARS[1]) .. " ›"
					statBtn.Text = (p.stattrak or STATTRAK[1]) .. " ›"
					for _, refresh in ipairs(refreshers) do refresh() end
					valueBox.Text = p.stattrakValue and tostring(p.stattrakValue) or ""
				end
			end)

			local rarityFilter = "All"
			local function slotLabel(slotCard, text, color)
				local label = slotCard:FindFirstChild("PickedName") or New("TextLabel", {
					Name = "PickedName", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -10), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					TextColor3 = MUTED, TextSize = 12, Font = FONT, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				}, slotCard)
				label.Text = text or ""
				local bar = slotCard:FindFirstChild("GradeBar")
				if bar then bar.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(176, 180, 192) end
			end
			local animateCards = false
			local function rebuildGrid(animated)
				animateCards = animated == true
				for _, c in ipairs(gridScroll:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end end
				if not current then return end
				local list = { { "No Skin", "Consumer" } }
				local extra = type(options.skins) == "table" and options.skins[current.item]
				if type(extra) == "table" then for _, sk in ipairs(extra) do table.insert(list, sk) end end
				local query = string.lower(search.Text or "")
				local chosen = pickOf().skin or "No Skin"
				for i, sk in ipairs(list) do
					local name, rarity = tostring(sk[1]), tostring(sk[2] or "Consumer")
					if (rarityFilter == "All" or rarity == rarityFilter) and (query == "" or string.find(string.lower(name), query, 1, true)) then
						local c = card(gridScroll, "Skin_" .. i)
						c.LayoutOrder = i
						c:FindFirstChild("GradeBar").BackgroundColor3 = rarityColor(rarity)
						local agentCard = current.item == "Agent"
						New("TextLabel", {
							Name = "SkinName", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -8), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = name, TextColor3 = name == chosen and TEXT or MUTED, TextSize = agentCard and 13 or 12, Font = FONT,
							-- Skins: centred in the card. Agents (Neverlose): name along the bottom.
							TextXAlignment = agentCard and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
							TextYAlignment = agentCard and Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
							TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						}, c)
						if agentCard and name == chosen then
							-- Picked agent: accent ring in the top-right corner.
							local mark = New("Frame", {
								Name = "PickedMark", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							}, c)
							New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, mark)
							local ring = Instance.new("UIStroke")
							ring.Color = mainColor
							ring.Thickness = 1.5
							ring.Parent = mark
							local dot = New("Frame", {
								Name = "Dot", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),
								BackgroundColor3 = mainColor, BorderSizePixel = 0,
							}, mark)
							New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, dot)
						end
						if name == chosen then
							local o = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
							if o then o.Color = rarityColor(rarity); o.Transparency = 0.3 end
						end
						-- Cards come in one after another (fade + rise).
						if animateCards then
							local order = c.LayoutOrder
							WindowObj._fadeTree(c, false, 0)
							local lift = New("UIPadding", { Name = "Lift", PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8) }, c)
							task.delay(math.min(order, 15) * 0.025, function()
								if not c.Parent then return end
								WindowObj._fadeTree(c, true, 0.22)
								Tween(lift, { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 0) }, 0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
							end)
						end
						c.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
							saveOption("skin", name)
							saveOption("rarity", rarity)
							Tween(rarityLine, { BackgroundColor3 = rarityColor(rarity) }, 0.2)
							if current.slot then slotLabel(current.slot, name ~= "No Skin" and name or "", rarityColor(rarity)) end
							if type(options.onSkin) == "function" then pcall(options.onSkin, team, current.category, current.index, current.item, name) end
							rebuildGrid()
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() rebuildGrid(true) end)
			rarityBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				local order = { "All" }
				for _, r in ipairs(RARITY) do table.insert(order, r[1]) end
				listMenu(rarityBtn, order, rarityFilter, function(v)
					rarityFilter = v
					rarityBtn.Text = "Rarity: " .. rarityFilter
					rarityBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.ceil(MeasureText(rarityBtn.Text, 13, FONT) + 20), 24)
					rebuildGrid(true)
				end)
			end)

			end)

			local function showLoadout(show)
				side.Visible = show
				grid.Visible = show
				itemPage.Visible = not show

					optionsPlate.Visible = false
					optionsPlate:SetAttribute("Open", false)
				end

			inv.open = function(category, index, item, slotCard)
				current = { category = category, index = index, item = item, key = category .. "#" .. index, slot = slotCard }
				local p = pickOf()
				title.Text = (TYPES[item] and p.type) or item
				rarityLine.BackgroundColor3 = rarityColor(p.rarity)
				typeBtn.Visible = TYPES[item] ~= nil
				typeBtn.Text = p.type or "Type"
				local isWeapon = WEAPONS[team][category] ~= nil
				switchBtn.Visible = isWeapon
				switchBtn.Text = item .. "  ⌄"
				switchBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.ceil(MeasureText(switchBtn.Text, 13, FONT) + 20), 24)
				search.Text = ""
				if inv.paintStickers then inv.paintStickers() end
				-- Agents (Neverlose): the agent stands on the left, the picker is a
				-- three-column grid of tall cards on the right.
				local isAgent = item == "Agent"
				local layout = gridScroll:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout")
				if previewFull then
					previewFull = false
					fullTitle.Visible, fullClose.Visible = false, false
					if homeParent then preview.Parent = homeParent end
					preview.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
				end
				preview.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40)
				toolbar.Visible, gridScroll.Visible = true, true
				preview.Size = isAgent and UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 1, -40) or UDim2.new(1, 0, PREVIEW_H, -40)
				toolbar.Position = isAgent and UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 40) or UDim2.new(0, 0, PREVIEW_H, 6)
				toolbar.Size = isAgent and UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 26) or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
				gridScroll.Position = isAgent and UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 74) or UDim2.new(0, 0, PREVIEW_H, 40)
				gridScroll.Size = isAgent and UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, -74) or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 - PREVIEW_H, -40)
				if layout then layout.CellSize = isAgent and UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 0, 112) or UDim2.new(0.2, -7, 0, 64) end
				refreshPreview()
				local wasOpen = itemPage.Visible
				showLoadout(false)
				if not wasOpen then
					-- Page fades in, title drops in, cards follow one by one.
					WindowObj._fadeTree(itemPage, true, 0)
					WindowObj._fadeTree(itemPage, false, 0)
					WindowObj._fadeTree(itemPage, true, 0.2)
					title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -8)
					Tween(title, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, 0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					rarityLine.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
					Tween(rarityLine, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 2) }, 0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
				end
				rebuildGrid(true)
			end
			switchBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if not current or not WEAPONS[team][current.category] then return end
				local list = WEAPONS[team][current.category]
				local nextIndex = current.index % #list + 1
				local slotCard
				for _, entry in ipairs(inv.slots) do
					if entry.key == current.category .. "#" .. nextIndex then slotCard = entry.card end
				end
				inv.open(current.category, nextIndex, list[nextIndex], slotCard)
			end)
			closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				-- Page fades out, then the loadout fades back in.
				WindowObj._fadeTree(itemPage, false, 0.14)
				task.delay(0.14, function()
					showLoadout(true)
					WindowObj._fadeTree(itemPage, true, 0)
					WindowObj._fadeColumn(Left)
				end)
			end)
			-- Slots show what was picked; switching team shows that team's picks.
			inv.refreshSlots = function()
				for _, entry in ipairs(inv.slots) do
					local p = picks[team][entry.key]
					slotLabel(entry.card, p and p.skin ~= "No Skin" and p.skin or "", p and rarityColor(p.rarity) or nil)
				end
			end
			WindowObj._configExtras["inventory"] = {
				get = function() return picks end,
				set = function(v)
					if type(v) ~= "table" then return end
					picks = { CT = type(v.CT) == "table" and v.CT or {}, T = type(v.T) == "table" and v.T or {} }
					inv.refreshSlots()
				end,
			}

				entry.button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if team ~= which then api:SetTeam(which) end end)
			end

		end

			local function MakeSettings(parentFrame, elementType, label)
				if settingsCache[parentFrame] then return settingsCache[parentFrame] end
				label = tostring(label or "")
				local settingsOpen = false
				local settingsLayoutConnection = nil

					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),

					BackgroundTransparency = 1,

				}, parentFrame)
				New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }, SettingsBtn)

				-- Library._fitRow, as in Neverlose ("Enabled  ...  [■] [switch]").

					New("Frame", {
						Name = "Dot" .. tostring(i + 1),
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (i - 1) * 5, 0.5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						ZIndex = 2001,
					}, SettingsBtn)
				end

				local SettingsHit = New("TextButton", {
					Name = "SettingsHit",
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Text = "",

					ZIndex = 2002,
				}, SettingsBtn)
				for _, dot in ipairs(SettingsBtn:GetChildren()) do

						dot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					end

				end)
				SettingsHit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
					SetDotsTransparency(0.1)
					if not settingsOpen then Tween(SettingsBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.15) end
				end)
				SetDotsTransparency(0.1)

				local SettingsFrame = Instance.new('Frame')

				SettingsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.045
				SettingsFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
				SettingsFrame.Visible = false
				SettingsFrame.ZIndex = 5000
				SettingsFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
				SettingsFrame.ClipsDescendants = false
				local SFScale = New("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, SettingsFrame)

				SettingsFrame.Parent = parentFrame

				UICorner.Name = "UICorner"

				local function UpdateSettingsLayout()
					local scale = GetMainFrameScale()
					SFContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0, PLATE_HEADER + 3 / scale)
					SFContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 1, -(PLATE_HEADER + 10 / scale))
				end

				local function GetSettingsContentHeight()
					local measured = MeasureRowsHeight(SFContainer)
					if measured > 0 then return measured end
					local rowCount = 0
					for _, child in ipairs(SFContainer:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("GuiObject") then rowCount = rowCount + 1 end
					end
					if rowCount <= 0 then return 0 end
					local estimated = EstimateRowsHeight(SFContainer, rowCount, 8.5)
					if estimated > 0 then return estimated end
					return rowCount * 34 * GetMainFrameScale()
				end

				local function getSettingsHeight()
					UpdateSettingsLayout()
					local scale = GetMainFrameScale()
					local contentVisual = GetSettingsContentHeight()
					local desiredVisual = math.max(34 * scale, contentVisual + (18 + PLATE_HEADER) * scale)
					return desiredVisual / scale
				end

				local function placeSettings(height)
					local scale = GetMainFrameScale()
					UpdateSettingsLayout()
					-- Opened plates may hang outside the menu (bounded by the screen);
					-- only the fixed section cards stay inside it.
					local mainPosition, mainSize = PopupSafeArea()
					local minHeight = 30
					local width = 330
					local edge = 5 * scale
					height = math.max(minHeight, type(height) == "number" and height == height and height or minHeight)
					local parentPosition = parentFrame.AbsolutePosition
					local parentSize = parentFrame.AbsoluteSize
					if mainSize.X <= 0 or mainSize.Y <= 0 or parentSize.X <= 0 or parentSize.Y <= 0 then return end
					local visualHeight = height * scale

					local mainLeft = mainPosition.X
					local mainRight = mainPosition.X + mainSize.X
					local mainTop = mainPosition.Y
					local mainBottom = mainPosition.Y + mainSize.Y

					local panelWidth = width * scale
					local leftX = SettingsBtn.AbsolutePosition.X + SettingsBtn.AbsoluteSize.X + 8 * scale
					local y = parentPosition.Y - 6 * scale
					-- Opened by a click: start just right of and a little above the cursor.
					local openX, openY = SettingsFrame:GetAttribute("OpenX"), SettingsFrame:GetAttribute("OpenY")
					if openX and openY then
						leftX = openX + 6 * scale
						y = openY - 10 * scale
					end
					leftX = math.clamp(leftX, mainLeft + edge, math.max(mainLeft + edge, mainRight - panelWidth - edge))
					-- Kept inside the window (pushed up only when it would leave it).
					y = math.clamp(y, mainTop + edge, math.max(mainTop + edge, mainBottom - visualHeight - edge))

					-- Relative to wherever the plate lives now (moved under the window).
					local host = SettingsFrame.Parent.AbsolutePosition
					SettingsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, (leftX - host.X) / scale, 0, (y - host.Y) / scale)
					SettingsFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
					task.defer(function()
						if SettingsFrame.Parent and SettingsFrame.Visible and visualHeight <= mainSize.Y then
							ConstrainPopupToMainFrame(SettingsFrame)
						end
					end)
				end

				local function closeSF()
					settingsOpen = false
					ClosePopupsUnder(SettingsFrame)
					UnregisterPopup(SettingsFrame)
					-- Fade out in place; shrinking the height used to cut the plate off.
					SmoothClose(SettingsFrame, 0.13)
					Tween(SFScale, {Scale = 0.94}, 0.13, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					Tween(SettingsBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12)
				end
				local SettingsObj = {}
				SettingsHit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					if settingsOpen then closeSF() else SettingsObj:Open() end
				end)

				local settingsElemCount = 0
				local SettingsFrame_Container = SFContainer

				-- Starts a new card in the plate; following Add* calls land in it.
				function SettingsObj:AddGroup()
					SettingsFrame_Container = StartPlateGroup(SFContainer)
					return self
				end

				function SettingsObj:Open()
					if settingsOpen then return self end
					settingsOpen = true
					-- Remember where it was clicked: the plate opens beside the cursor.
					local pointer = GetPointerPosition()
					SettingsFrame:SetAttribute("OpenX", pointer.X)
					SettingsFrame:SetAttribute("OpenY", pointer.Y - (WindowObj._topInset or 0))
					CloseAllPopupsExcept(SettingsFrame)
					RememberPopupClipping(SettingsFrame)
					ForceLiftClipping(SettingsFrame)
					SettingsFrame.Visible = false
					SFScale.Scale = 0.9
					ApplyZIndexLadder(SettingsFrame, NextPopupZ())
					placeSettings(getSettingsHeight())
					WindowObj._glassPlate(SettingsFrame)
					SmoothOpen(SettingsFrame, WindowObj._plateAlpha, 0.18)
					-- Pops out of the dots (UIScale grows from the plate's top-left).
					Tween(SFScale, {Scale = 1}, 0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					-- The dots stay highlighted while their plate is open, as in Neverlose.
					if not SettingsBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }, SettingsBtn) end
					SettingsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
					-- (Arrow rows use the whole row as the button: no highlight.)
					if not SettingsBtn:GetAttribute("RowHit") then Tween(SettingsBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 }, 0.12) end
					RegisterPopup(SettingsFrame, closeSF, SettingsBtn)
					local function settle()
						if not settingsOpen or not SettingsFrame.Parent then return end
						placeSettings(getSettingsHeight())
					end
					task.defer(settle)
					task.delay(0.05, settle)
					-- Guarantee the glass end state even if another tween touched it.
					task.delay(0.25, function() if settingsOpen then SettingsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = WindowObj._plateAlpha end end)
					if not settingsLayoutConnection then
						local okLayout, layout = pcall(function() return SFContainer:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") end)
						if okLayout and layout then
							pcall(function()
								settingsLayoutConnection = layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
									if settingsOpen then task.defer(function() if settingsOpen then placeSettings(getSettingsHeight()) end end) end
								end)
							end)
						end
					end
					return self
				end

				function SettingsObj:Close()
					if settingsOpen then closeSF() end
					return self
				end

					local function Set(val)
						enabled = val == true
						Tween(Effect, { BackgroundColor3 = enabled and mainColor or Color3.fromRGB(8, 10, 16) }, 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)
						Tween(Icon, { Position = enabled and UDim2.fromOffset(15, 2) or UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(139, 145, 157), BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
						InvokeCallback(callback, enabled)
					end

					Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Set(not enabled) end)

					local obj = {}
					function obj:Set(v) Set(v) end
					function obj:Get() return enabled end
					obj._row = Toggle
					-- A plate switch can carry its own plate ("..." beside it).
					function obj:AddSettings() return MakeSettings(Toggle, "toggle", text) end
					-- "..." with the watermark's settings as a normal menu plate. Right-
					-- clicking the watermark opens this same plate.
					function obj:AddWatermarkSettings()
						-- "..." opens the watermark's own settings plate (the one
						-- right-clicking the strip opens).
						return self:AddDots(function(dots) WindowObj:OpenWatermarkSettings(dots) end)
					end
					-- Or "..." that runs fn(dots) (e.g. Win:OpenWatermarkSettings).
					function obj:AddDots(fn)
						local gear = New("Frame", {
							Name = "SettingsGear", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, 0),
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2000,
						}, Toggle)
						gear:SetAttribute("AutoPlace", true)
						New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }, gear)
						for i = 0, 2 do
							New("Frame", {
								Name = "Dot" .. (i + 1), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (i - 1) * 5, 0.5, 0),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
								BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2001,
							}, gear)
						end
						local hit = New("TextButton", {
							Name = "SettingsHit", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 2002,
						}, gear)
						hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(gear, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.93 }, 0.12) end)
						hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(gear, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.15) end)
						hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() InvokeCallback(fn, hit) end)
						return self
					end
					RegisterConfigElement("settings_toggle_", text, obj)
					-- Plate functions get binds, tooltips and SetDisabled like section ones.
					BindElementContext(Toggle, "settings_toggle", text, obj, obj:Get())
					return obj
				end

				-- Colour square on a plate row (Neverlose "Player  [■] Disabled >"):
				-- above the row's click area, opens the colour picker, saved in configs.
				function SettingsObj:_swatch(row, text, color, onColor)
					local sw = New("ImageButton", {
						Name = "PlateSwatch", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0.5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, Image = "",
						AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 1012,
					}, row)
					New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }, sw)
					Stroke(sw, "PlateSwatchStroke")
					-- The picker is built on the first click: a plate full of colour
					-- squares used to build every picker up front (memory, load time).
					-- Its own click handler takes over from the next click on.
					local picker
					local current = color
					sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
						if picker then return end
						picker = AcrylicBlur.CreateColorPicker(sw, current, function(c)
							current = c
							InvokeCallback(onColor, c)
						end)
						picker.Toggle()
					end)
					local cobj = {}
					function cobj:Set(c)
						local normalized = NormalizeColor(c)
						current = normalized
						if picker then picker.Set(normalized) else sw.BackgroundColor3 = normalized end
						InvokeCallback(onColor, normalized)
					end
					function cobj:Get() return current end
					RegisterConfigElement("settings_swatch_", text, cobj)
					return sw, cobj
				end

				-- Colour + switch: callback(color, enabled).
				function SettingsObj:AddColorToggle(text, defaultColor, defaultEnabled, callback)
					if type(defaultEnabled) == "function" then callback, defaultEnabled = defaultEnabled, false end
					local state = { color = NormalizeColor(defaultColor), enabled = defaultEnabled == true }
					local t = self:AddToggle(text, state.enabled, function(on)
						state.enabled = on
						InvokeCallback(callback, state.color, on)
					end)
					local _, cobj = self:_swatch(t._row, text, state.color, function(c)
						state.color = c
						InvokeCallback(callback, c, state.enabled)
					end)
					function t:SetColor(c) cobj:Set(c) end
					function t:GetColor() return cobj:Get() end
					return t
				end

				-- Colour + list ("[■] Disabled >"): callback(option), colorCallback(color).
				function SettingsObj:AddDropdownColorpicker(text, options, defaultColor, callback, colorCallback)
					local d = self:AddDropdown(text, options, nil, callback)
					local sw, cobj = self:_swatch(d._row, text, NormalizeColor(defaultColor), colorCallback)
					-- The square sits just left of the value, whatever its width.
					local valueLabel = d._row:FindFirstChild("TextDefault")
					local function place()
						local w = valueLabel and valueLabel.TextBounds.X or 60
						sw.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(24 + math.ceil(w) + 10), 0.5, 0)
					end
					if valueLabel then valueLabel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(place) end
					place()
					function d:SetColor(c) cobj:Set(c) end
					function d:GetColor() return cobj:Get() end
					return d
				end

				function SettingsObj:AddSlider(text, min, max, default, callback, suffix)
					settingsElemCount = settingsElemCount + 1
					if type(suffix) ~= "string" then suffix = "" end
					local value
					min, max, value = NormalizeRange(min, max, default)
					value = Quantize(value, min, max, GetSliderStep(min, max))
					local initRatio = (value - min) / (max - min)
					local dragging = false

					local Slider = New("Frame", {
						Name = "Slider",
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(162, 162, 162),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						LayoutOrder = settingsElemCount,
						ZIndex = 1000,
					}, SettingsFrame_Container)

New("Frame", {
						Name = "Lines",
						Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 1, -1),
						Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0, 1),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(162, 162, 162),
						BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
						ZIndex = 1002,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
					}, Slider)

					New("TextLabel", {
						Name = "TextToggle",
						Position = UDim2.new(0.04800000086426735, 0, 0.30000001192092896, 0),
						Size = UDim2.new(0.36, 0, 0.6000000238418579, 0),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28,32,48),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Text = text,
						TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
						TextScaled = false,
						Font = FONT,
						TextTransparency = 0,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						ZIndex = 1001,
					}, Slider)

					local Effect = New("Frame", {
						Name = "Effect",
						Position = UDim2.new(0.4980000042915344, 0, 0.25, 0),
						Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.6990000009536743, 0),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						ZIndex = 1001,
					}, Slider)

					local SliderValue = New("TextLabel", {
						Name = "SliderValue",
						Position = UDim2.new(0.6990000009536743, 0, 0.10000000149011612, 0),
						Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0.8080000281333923, 0),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33,37,53),
						Text = FormatSliderValue(value, suffix),
						TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
						TextScaled = false,
						Font = FONT,
						TextTransparency = 0.20000000298023224,
						ZIndex = 1002,
					}, Effect)
					New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }, SliderValue)

					local Line = New("Frame", {
						Name = "Line",
						Active = true,
						Position = UDim2.new(0.03999999910593033, 0, 0.3190000057220459, 0),
						Size = UDim2.new(0.6000000238418579, 0, 0.24, 0),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33,37,53),
						ZIndex = 1001,
					}, Effect)
					New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, Line)

					local InLine = New("Frame", {
						Name = "InLine",
						Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
						BackgroundColor3 = mainColor,
						ZIndex = 1002,
					}, Line)
					New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, InLine)
					SizeSliderChip(Effect, Line, SliderValue)
					Effect.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
					Effect.Position = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0.5, 0)
					Effect.Size = UDim2.new(0.55, -14, 0, 22)
					Line.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SliderValue.Size.X.Offset + 10), 0, 3)
					Line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)

					local Trigger = New("TextButton", {
						Name = "Trigger",
						Position = UDim2.new(0.10000000149011612, 0, -1.8000000715255737, 0),
						Size = UDim2.new(1.1999999284744263, 0, 4.200000286102295, 0),
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.800000011920929, 0),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Active = false,
						Text = "",
						ZIndex = 1003,
					}, Line)
					New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, Trigger)
					New("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {}, Trigger)
					local Thumb = New("Frame", {
						Name = "Thumb",
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.new(initRatio, 0, 0.5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 255),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						ZIndex = Line.ZIndex + 3,
					}, Line)
					New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, Thumb)
					Stroke(Thumb)
					-- Plate sliders on Neverlose are a bare bar: no knob, no readout,
					-- and the whole 22px strip around the bar takes the drag (the
					-- 3px bar alone was hard to hit).
					Thumb.Visible = false
					-- Plate bar: a tall invisible hit strip around a 4px track, and the
					-- value as plain grey text at a fixed width (SizeSliderChip keeps it so;
					-- resizing it per value made the bar jump shorter while dragging).
					Line:SetAttribute("PlateBar", true)
					-- The section slider's hit button is scaled from the bar height:
					-- on the 22px strip it grew to ~90px and swallowed the clicks.
					Trigger.Visible = false
					Line.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					SizeSliderChip(Effect, Line, SliderValue)
					local Track = New("Frame", {
						Name = "Track", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 64), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Line.ZIndex,
					}, Line)
					New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, Track)
					InLine.Parent = Track
					local initialValue = value
					task.defer(function()
						if value ~= initialValue then return end
						InLine.Size = UDim2.fromScale(initRatio, 1)
						Thumb.Position = UDim2.new(initRatio, 0, 0.5, 0)
						Trigger.Position = UDim2.new(initRatio, 0, -1.8000000715255737, 0)
					end)

					local function update(input)
						local pointer = GetInputPosition(input)
						local lineSize = Line.AbsoluteSize.X
						if lineSize <= 0 then return end
						local sizeScale = ClampRatio(pointer.X - Line.AbsolutePosition.X, lineSize)
						local nextValue = Quantize(((max - min) * sizeScale) + min, min, max, GetSliderStep(min, max))
						local changed = nextValue ~= value
						value = nextValue
						local span = max - min
						local snappedRatio = span ~= 0 and math.clamp((value - min) / span, 0, 1) or 0
						InLine.Size = UDim2.fromScale(snappedRatio, 1)
						Trigger.Position = UDim2.new(snappedRatio, 0, -1.8000000715255737, 0)
						Thumb.Position = UDim2.new(snappedRatio, 0, 0.5, 0)
						SliderValue.Text = WindowObj._sliderText(SliderValue, value, suffix)
						if changed then InvokeCallback(callback, value) end
					end

					Line.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
						if IsPrimaryInput(input) then
							dragging = true; update(input)
						end
					end)
					UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
						if IsPrimaryInput(input) then
							dragging = false
						end
					end)
					UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
						if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
							update(input)
						end
					end)

					local obj = {}
					function obj:Set(val)
						local numeric = type(val) == "number" and val == val and val or min
						value = math.clamp(numeric, min, max)
						value = Quantize(value, min, max, GetSliderStep(min, max))
					local span = max - min
					local ratio = span ~= 0 and math.clamp((value - min) / span, 0, 1) or 0
						Tween(InLine, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1) }, 0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
						Trigger.Position = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, -1.8000000715255737, 0)
						Tween(Thumb, { Position = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, 0.5, 0) }, 0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
						SliderValue.Text = WindowObj._sliderText(SliderValue, value, suffix)
						InvokeCallback(callback, value)
					end
					function obj:Get() return value end
					RegisterConfigElement("settings_slider_", text, obj)
					-- Plate functions get binds, tooltips and SetDisabled like section ones.
					BindElementContext(Slider, "settings_slider", text, obj, obj:Get(), nil, min, max)
					return obj
				end

					local function updateCheckmarks()
						for opt, selBtn in pairs(selectedBtns) do
							local isSelected = (multi and picked[opt] == true) or (not multi and opt == selected)
							selBtn.Visible = isSelected
							selBtn.ImageColor3 = mainColor
							local row = selBtn.Parent
							if row then
								row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
								local label = row:FindFirstChild("Label") or row:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
								if label then label.TextColor3 = isSelected and Color3.fromRGB(228, 228, 229) or Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 180) end
							end
						end
					end

					for i, opt in ipairs(options) do

							ZIndex = 5001,
							LayoutOrder = i,
						}, DropContainer)
						New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, BtnRow)

						New("TextLabel", {
							Name = "Label",
							Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 0),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 1, 0),

							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = opt,
							TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 204, 218),
							TextScaled = false,
							TextSize = 14,
							Font = FONT,
							TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
							TextTransparency = 0,
							ZIndex = 5002,
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						}, BtnRow)

						local SelBtn = New("ImageButton", {
						Name = "Selected",
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Image = "rbxassetid://138494545053627",
						ImageColor3 = mainColor,
						Visible = false,
						ZIndex = 5006,
					}, BtnRow)
					selectedBtns[opt] = SelBtn

						local RowBtn = New("TextButton", {
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Text = "",
							ZIndex = 5005,
						}, BtnRow)
						RowBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if Library._hoverBlocked(RowBtn) then return end
							Tween(BtnRow, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.97 }, 0.08)
						end)
						RowBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
							Tween(BtnRow, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12)
						end)
						local function pick()
							if multi then
								picked[opt] = not picked[opt] or nil
								local list = {}
								for _, o in ipairs(options) do if picked[o] then table.insert(list, o) end end
								TextDefault.Text = #list > 0 and table.concat(list, ", ") or "None"
								updateCheckmarks()
								InvokeCallback(callback, list)
								return
							end
							selected = opt
							TextDefault.Text = opt
							updateCheckmarks()
							closeDropdown()
							InvokeCallback(callback, opt)
						end
						RowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(pick)
						SelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(pick)
					end

					local OpenBtn = New("TextButton", {
						Name = "OpenBtn",
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Text = "",
						ZIndex = 1500,
					}, Selection)
					OpenBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
						if dropOpen then closeDropdown()
						else
							CloseAllPopupsExcept(DropPopup)
							dropOpen = true
							local popupW = Library._listWidth(options, TextDefault.AbsoluteSize.X)
							local popupH = math.min(#options, 8) * 30 + 10
							DropPopup.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(popupW, popupH)
							DropPopup.BackgroundTransparency = 0
							DropPopup.Visible = false
							ApplyZIndexLadder(DropPopup, NextPopupZ())
							DropPopup.Visible = true
							WindowObj._centerPopupOnField(DropPopup, TextDefault)
							SmoothOpen(DropPopup, 0, 0.14)
							RegisterPopup(DropPopup, closeDropdown, OpenBtn)
						end
					end)

					if multi then
						local list = {}
						for _, o in ipairs(options) do if picked[o] then table.insert(list, o) end end
						TextDefault.Text = #list > 0 and table.concat(list, ", ") or "None"
					else
						TextDefault.Text = selected
					end
					updateCheckmarks()

					local obj = {}
					function obj:Set(val, silent)
			val = GetValidOption(options, val)
			selected = val
			TextDefault.Text = val
			updateCheckmarks()
			if not silent then InvokeCallback(callback, val) end
		end
					function obj:Get()
						if not multi then return selected end
						local list = {}
						for _, o in ipairs(options) do if picked[o] then table.insert(list, o) end end
						return list
					end
					if multi then
						function obj:Set(val, silent)
							picked = {}
							for _, v in ipairs(type(val) == "table" and val or { val }) do picked[tostring(v)] = true end
							local list = obj:Get()
							TextDefault.Text = #list > 0 and table.concat(list, ", ") or "None"
							updateCheckmarks()
							if not silent then InvokeCallback(callback, list) end
						end
					end
					obj._row = Selection
					RegisterConfigElement("settings_dropdown_", text, obj)
					-- Plate functions get binds, tooltips and SetDisabled like section ones.
					BindElementContext(Selection, "settings_dropdown", text, obj, obj:Get(), options)
					return obj
				end

				function SettingsObj:AddColorpicker(text, defaultColor, callback)
					settingsElemCount = settingsElemCount + 1

						Size = UDim2.new(0.68, 0, 1, 0),

						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
						BackgroundColor3 = initialColor,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Image = "",
						ZIndex = 1010,
					}, Colorpicker)
					New("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }, colorpickerButton)
					Stroke(colorpickerButton, "ColorpickerButtonStroke")

					-- Plate functions get binds, tooltips and SetDisabled like section ones.
